meta.title: Sign In to Sentinel
meta.desc: Validates Sentinel access and opens browser-based Azure sign-in if a cached token is not available yet.

compute.expr: $type(fetched_sources.sign_in) = 'object' and fetched_sources.sign_in.account.user.name ? '**Signed in as:** ' & fetched_sources.sign_in.account.user.name : $type(fetched_sources.sign_in) = 'object' and fetched_sources.sign_in.account.name ? '**Sentinel login ready for:** ' & fetched_sources.sign_in.account.name : $type(fetched_sources.sign_in) = 'string' ? '**Sentinel sign-in failed:** ' & fetched_sources.sign_in : '**Sentinel sign-in status unavailable**'

$type(fetched_sources.sign_in) = 'object' and fetched_sources.sign_in.promptedLogin ? 'A browser sign-in was prompted and the Sentinel token cache was refreshed.' : $type(fetched_sources.sign_in) = 'object' and fetched_sources.sign_in.tokenAcquired ? 'Existing Azure CLI login was reused for Sentinel.' : $type(fetched_sources.sign_in) = 'string' ? fetched_sources.sign_in : 'The backend could not validate Sentinel auth. Enable Force browser sign-in and refresh.'

forceLogin.title: Force browser sign-in on next refresh
